actions.code: (() => { const debug = {}; debug.url = window.location.href; debug.title = document.title; debug.userAgent = navigator.userAgent; debug.bodyExists = !!document.body; if (!document.body) { return JSON.stringify({error: 'body不存在', debug}); } debug.bodyLength = document.body.innerHTML.length; debug.bodyPreview = document.body.innerHTML.substring(0, 2000); const containersAll = document.querySelectorAll('div.list-col > div.p-b-15'); const containersFiltered = document.querySelectorAll('div.list-col > div.p-b-15:not([data-group])'); debug.containerCountAll = containersAll.length; debug.containerCountFiltered = containersFiltered.length; debug.dataGroupCount = containersAll.length - containersFiltered.length; if (containersFiltered.length > 0) { debug.firstContainer = containersFiltered[0].innerHTML.substring(0, 500); } else { const listCol = document.querySelector('div.list-col'); debug.listColExists = !!listCol; if (listCol) { debug.listColChildren = listCol.children.length; debug.listColClasses = Array.from(listCol.children).map(c => c.className).join(', '); debug.listColHTML = listCol.innerHTML.substring(0, 1500); } else { const allDivs = document.querySelectorAll('div[class*="list"]'); debug.listRelatedDivs = Array.from(allDivs).slice(0, 10).map(d => d.className).join(' | '); debug.bodyStructure = document.body.innerHTML.substring(0, 3000); } debug.totalDivs = document.querySelectorAll('div').length; const cloudflare = document.querySelector('#challenge-form') || document.querySelector('.cf-browser-verification'); debug.cloudflare = !!cloudflare; } return JSON.stringify(debug); })();

search.description: 搜索漫画（支持关键词、ID、标签排除）

actions.code: (() => { const query = '{{query}}'; const baseUrl = '{{baseUrl}}'; const page = {{page}} || 1; let url = ''; if (query.match(/^(JM)?\d+$/)) { const id = query.replace(/^JM/, ''); url = baseUrl + '/album/' + id; console.log('[搜索] ID搜索模式: ' + url); } else if (query.includes('-')) { const removedGenres = query.split(' ').filter(t => t.startsWith('-')).map(t => t.substring(1)).join('+'); url = baseUrl + '/albums?page=' + page + '&screen=' + removedGenres; console.log('[搜索] 标签排除模式: ' + url); } else { const searchQuery = query.replace(/\+/g, '%2B').replace(/ /g, '+'); url = baseUrl + '/search/photos?search_query=' + searchQuery + '&page=' + page; console.log('[搜索] 关键词搜索模式: ' + url); } return url; })();
actions.description: 根据查询类型动态构建搜索URL

actions.code: (() => { console.log('[Base64解码] 开始查找加密内容'); const scripts = document.querySelectorAll('#wrapper > script'); let decoded = false; for(let script of scripts) { const code = script.innerHTML; if(code.includes('base64DecodeUtf8') && code.includes('document.write(html)')) { console.log('[Base64解码] 找到加密脚本'); const lines = code.split('\n'); for(let line of lines) { const trimmed = line.trim(); if(trimmed.startsWith('const html') || trimmed.startsWith('let html') || trimmed.startsWith('var html')) { const match = trimmed.match(/base64DecodeUtf8\("([^"]+)"\)/); if(match) { try { const decodedHtml = atob(match[1]); document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', decodedHtml); console.log('[Base64解码] 成功解码并注入内容，长度: ' + decodedHtml.length); decoded = true; break; } catch(e) { console.error('[Base64解码] 解码失败:', e); } } } } if(decoded) break; } } return decoded ? 'DECODED' : 'NO_ENCODED_CONTENT'; })();

(() => { const result = { id: '{{mangaId}}', title: document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent?.trim() || '', cover: '', author: '', genre: '', status: 0, description: '' }; let thumbImg = document.querySelector('.thumb-overlay > img'); if(!thumbImg) { thumbImg = document.querySelector('.thumb-overlay img'); } if(!thumbImg) { thumbImg = document.querySelector('img[itemprop=image]'); } if(!thumbImg) { thumbImg = document.querySelector('.panel-body img[src*="media/albums"]'); } if(thumbImg) { let coverUrl = thumbImg.getAttribute('data-original') || thumbImg.getAttribute('src') || thumbImg.getAttribute('data-cfsrc') || ''; if(coverUrl && !coverUrl.includes('blank.jpg')) { result.cover = coverUrl.replace(/\?.*$/, ''); } else { const allImgs = document.querySelectorAll('img[src*="media/albums"]'); for(let img of allImgs) { const src = img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || ''; if(src && !src.includes('blank.jpg')) { result.cover = src.replace(/\?.*$/, ''); break; } } } } const tagBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('div.panel-body div.tag-block'); if(tagBlocks.length >= 4) { const authorLinks = tagBlocks[3].querySelectorAll('.btn-primary'); result.author = Array.from(authorLinks).map(a => a.textContent.trim()).join(', '); } const genreSpan = document.querySelector('span[itemprop=genre]'); if(genreSpan) { const genreLinks = genreSpan.querySelectorAll('a'); const genres = []; genreLinks.forEach(link => { const text = link.textContent.trim(); if(text === '連載中') { result.status = 1; } else if(text === '完結') { result.status = 2; } else { genres.push(text); } }); result.genre = genres.join(', '); } const descElem = document.querySelector('#intro-block .p-t-5.p-b-5'); if(descElem) { result.description = descElem.textContent.trim().replace(/^敘述：/, ''); } console.log('[漫画详情] 提取结果:', result); return JSON.stringify(result); })();
actions.description: 提取漫画详情信息（修复封面提取）

getChapterList.description: 获取章节列表（含Base64解码和单章节处理）

actions.code: (() => { const scripts = document.querySelectorAll('#wrapper > script'); for(let script of scripts) { const code = script.innerHTML; if(code.includes('base64DecodeUtf8')) { const lines = code.split('\n'); for(let line of lines) { const trimmed = line.trim(); if(trimmed.startsWith('const html') || trimmed.startsWith('let html') || trimmed.startsWith('var html')) { const match = trimmed.match(/base64DecodeUtf8\("([^"]+)"\)/); if(match) { try { const decodedHtml = atob(match[1]); document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', decodedHtml); console.log('[章节列表] Base64解码成功'); break; } catch(e) {} } } } } } return 'DECODED'; })();

(() => { console.log('[章节列表] 开始提取'); const chapters = []; const chapterLinks = document.querySelectorAll('div[id=episode-block] a[href^="/photo/"]'); if(chapterLinks.length === 0) { console.log('[章节列表] 未找到章节列表，检查是否为单章节漫画'); const singleChapterLink = document.querySelector('#album_photo_cover > div.thumb-overlay > a'); if(singleChapterLink) { const dateElem = document.querySelector('[itemprop=datePublished]'); chapters.push({ id: singleChapterLink.getAttribute('href'), title: '单章节', publishTime: dateElem ? dateElem.getAttribute('content') : '' }); console.log('[章节列表] 单章节漫画'); } } else { chapterLinks.forEach(link => { const url = link.getAttribute('href'); const titleElem = link.querySelector('li h3'); const dateElem = link.querySelector('li span.hidden-xs'); if(url && titleElem) { chapters.push({ id: url, title: titleElem.textContent.trim(), publishTime: dateElem ? dateElem.textContent.trim() : '' }); } }); chapters.reverse(); console.log('[章节列表] 找到 ' + chapters.length + ' 个章节'); } return JSON.stringify(chapters); })();
actions.description: 提取章节列表（支持单章节）

getPageList.description: 获取章节页面列表（递归处理分页）

actions.code: (() => { console.log('[页面列表] 开始递归收集'); const pages = []; const visited = new Set(); async function fetchPage(url) { if(visited.has(url)) return; visited.add(url); console.log('[页面列表] 获取页面: ' + url); let doc = document; if(url !== window.location.href) { try { const response = await fetch(url); const html = await response.text(); const parser = new DOMParser(); doc = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html'); } catch(e) { console.error('[页面列表] 获取页面失败:', e); return; } } const imgs = doc.querySelectorAll('div.center.scramble-page.spnotice_chk[id*="0"] img'); imgs.forEach(img => { let imageUrl = img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || img.getAttribute('data-cfsrc') || ''; if(imageUrl && !imageUrl.includes('blank.jpg')) { imageUrl = imageUrl.split('?')[0]; if(!pages.some(p => p.imageUrl === imageUrl)) { pages.push({ imageUrl: imageUrl, page: pages.length }); } } }); const nextLink = doc.querySelector('a.prevnext'); if(nextLink) { const nextUrl = nextLink.href || nextLink.getAttribute('href'); if(nextUrl && !visited.has(nextUrl)) { await fetchPage(nextUrl.startsWith('http') ? nextUrl : window.location.origin + nextUrl); } } } window.__pageListPromise = fetchPage(window.location.href).then(() => { console.log('[页面列表] 收集完成，共 ' + pages.length + ' 页'); window.__pageListResult = JSON.stringify({ totalPages: pages.length, pages: pages }); }); return 'ASYNC_STARTED'; })();
actions.description: 异步递归收集所有页面

actions.code: (() => { const result = window.__pageListResult || JSON.stringify({ totalPages: 0, pages: [] }); delete window.__pageListResult; delete window.__pageListPromise; console.log('[页面列表] 返回结果'); return result; })();

getImageUrl.description: 获取图片URL（将由图片解扰拦截器处理）

notes: 本图源基于 Kotlin 版本移植，保留了所有核心功能
图片解扰功能需要系统支持 imageDescrambler 模块
Base64 解码用于漫画详情页和章节列表
支持三种搜索模式：ID搜索(JM123456)、关键词搜索(A +B)、标签排除(-YAOI)
建议使用默认速率限制设置以避免IP被封禁
如遇访问问题，请在设置中切换域名
